book.name: Aposel
book.title: APOSEL Aposel wagle kongun erikwa kamo

content: Yagl ta kagle siyungwa Pita erewakai orkwa
Enge suwarata 3 klok orkwa kamun pokndungo, kamange ere-ere erikwa enge yongo, ana Pita ya Jon ende God holi yungumo mina embrika.

Ana togl dra ta igle yongwa i kangiye ‘Wakai-yene’ we dingwa. Ana yagl ta mam kugl yomara kagle siyungwa, yomba engenge yaglmo i bagl yombugl ipi endingo togl dra mina igle paimogl ana yomba ende God holi yungumo mina enamunedi eingwa i ye moni pre yana di-di orkwa.
Yaglmo i kango Pita ya Jon ende suna enambugledi euriko, ana ye krapogl tendre moni ta nartro dungwa.
Ba Pita ya Jon toro mendigl pandigl kan ye moglmara endimbriko ana Pita yegl ditongwa, “Ene no kano!”
Yegl dungo ana taragl ta tembir ye inagledi pre kan ye miurara endungwa.
Ba Pita yegl ditongwa, “Na moni kaima ta paikrukwa, ba taragl ta i-waninga i ene tenaglka; i Yesus Krais Nasaret nem kangiye mina na ka dinga, ene andigl ana konbo endpo!”
Ana Pita eremogl yaglmo andrambedi pre ongo wokra akindre akepledi tongwa. Ana oglandi yene yaglmo kagle ya te goglko gigle dungwa.
Ye puglondi andigltre ana konbauna mambuno ere pindre, ana ye Pita ya Jon bogl akiye ende God holi yungumo togl suna eingo ye konbo wan winambo dindre, puglo giandi ana God dembiye karaugl eretongwa.
Te yomba prapra igle meglkwa ikra kanigwa yaglmo konbo wopindre ana God dembiye karaugl eretongwa,
ana yomba kanpogl singwa yagl i togl dra “Wakai-yene” we dimara igle amedi mogltre ana taragl yana di-di orkwa yaglmo ikra, ye kagle wu wakai ongo ana yomba kandre sipuglodi keglango erikwa.
God holi yungumo yungugl kra Pita ka mambuno dungwa
Yaglmo i eremogl Pita ya Jon embirara ake budi pango ende Solomon weradamo we dimara igle eingo, ana yomba merkinde i kandre sipuglodi ana mukundi ende ye meglmara wingwa.

Pita eremogl yomba i kandre ka yegl ditongwa, “Israel yomba, ene sraglpre taragl orkwa ipre pir yumbun deme? Ene sraglpre no suwo toro ningadi kanime? Ene pirkwa no nono yomburo mina mo God ongumuglo mina no wakai mogltre ana yagl i erewakai eretembriko konbauna wanmedi pirim kana? Tamanga.

Abraham ya Aisak ya Jekop Godno, te ama nono kowano ye Godno, ye kongunmo yomba Yesus kangiye kande dembiyesi mitna ende tongwa. Ana yaglmo i sigoraglmedi pre ene mokono tendre yomba kande wagle teingo, ana Pailat ka-tange sigoglkraglme dungwa. Ba Pailat dungwa i ene mane dindre sigolo dingwa.
Yombamo ye Holi mogltre te ama du-yene moglkwa, ba okuna ene eremogl ye wedi pirkre mokono tendre ana ene yagl ta yomba sigogl kane pangwa ikra imenda ende norambedi pre krapogl Pailat teingwa.
Ba ye kor aimande mogl enamga i-nongugl ende norkwa ikra ene sigeglkwa. Ba ye gogl pango ana God ikor endungwa, i no ongumutno mina kaima kambuglka pre kamo dumbuglka.

Ye kangiye mina yombuglo tongo yagl moglkwa suglo kagle wakai orkwa. Ana yagle ye ene pirkan erikwa, i no Yesus kangiye pirngi dumbuglka pre taragl i plau dungwa, te no ombugl Yesus wedi pirngi dumbuglara igle yagl kagle siyungwa ikra wakai orko ene prapra kanigwa.
“Angrima wagle, na erme pirkan erika, ene yombano kande bogl mambuno kaima pir pogl sikre Yesus erekinde ereteingwa.
Ba God Mesaiamo giu yegl gogl gorambuka ipre okuna imbo propet wagle drano mina God ka-dem dungwa ikra paiyungwa.
Ipre ene erme nomano yake tendre ende ikine God mina wimbi, ana ene tandaglmeno ye koko ende tenambuka.
Ene yegl erimbi ana Spirit ene nomano sikor endinambuka engemo i Yaglkande mina unambuka, te ye ombugl Yesus diendinambuka, ye Mesaia, i Yaglkande ene pre kamkand pinde i-pere endungwa.
Ye heven mogl panan ana God taragl prapra ere-ikor endinambuka engemo yenambuka, i okuna imbo ye propetma holi wagle ka i drano mina yongo ka dipandiglmere.
Sraglpre, Moses ka yegl dungwa, ‘Yaglkande ene Godno, enene yombano i mina ye propet ta na mereyegl i-nongugl ende tenambuka. Ye ka prapra ditenambuka i ene piraglkwa.
Ana yomba ta propet i kamo pirkraglkwa ye God siderwagl baruwagl eran ana God yombamo i mina suna moglkraglkwa.’
“Kaima yene propet okuna meglkwa ye God kamo dingwa, i Samuel mina mambuno bogl ende wu propet tau mokomugl wingwa, ye prapra taragl erme plau dungwa ipre kamo dem okuna dipandiglkwa.

Propet okuna mogl-wingwa ikra ye gawano ene meglkwa, te ene yagl awano God bogl nomano suwara yei digi dingwa. Ana God kontrak digidi yagl awano tomara igle ama ene meglkwa. God ka yegl di Abraham tongwa, ‘Ene nangitn ya gawan mina ipre ere makandle yomba prapra akepledi erewakai eretenaglka.’

Ana God nigl-kongunmo yomba ta i-pendigl ende ana diendungo wu ene meglmara komnaiye moglkwa, i ye erewakai ere ene tendre te suwara suwarandi akeple ditenan ana tandaglme kinde kanekane erikwa i mokono te kondinaglkwa.”

footnotes.text: Ka i propet ta God di endinan unambe dungwa. Kamo i pepa Lo mina 18:15-19. Pita yegl dungwa, Yesus ye propet i moglme dungwa.
